data.title: Triton Minerals Announces Board Changes
data.description:
Triton Minerals Limited ( (AU:TON) ) just unveiled an announcement.

Triton Minerals Limited announced immediate changes to its board, appointing Chengzhou Hou as chairman and director and Bingchao Yan as a director. The appointments followed nominations by Jigao International Investment Development Co., Ltd under director nomination arrangements in a 25 June 2019 Subscription Agreement.

Peng (Rod) Zhang and Xingmin (Max) Ji resigned as directors, effective immediately. Hou brings corporate, investment and management experience, while Yan is a qualified mining engineer with experience in mine operations, engineering, project development, safety and technical management.

The board now comprises Hou, executive director Adrian Costello, non-executive director Yang Li and Yan. Remuneration and other appointment terms for Hou and Yan are still being finalized.

data.title: Titomic outlines corporate governance practices and board oversight
data.description:
Titomic Ltd ( (AU:TTT) ) has provided an update.

Titomic, Inc. is a Delaware corporation whose directors and management say they are committed to ethical business conduct and the highest corporate-governance standards. The company has adopted and substantially complies with the ASX Corporate Governance Principles and Recommendations (Fourth Edition), to the extent appropriate for its size and the nature of its operations.

Its governance statement, approved by the Board as at 30 November 2026, sets out its practices and identifies any recommendations not followed, together with reasons. The Board oversees management, governance, strategy, operational and financial performance, and the annual business plan and budget, while the Managing Director operates within Board-delegated authority and remains accountable through regular reporting.

Before appointing a director or putting forward a candidate for election, the company undertakes checks on character, experience, education, criminal record and bankruptcy history. It also provides security holders with material information relevant to director election or re-election decisions.

data.title: Nankai to Dispose of Treasury Shares Under Employee Restricted Stock Plan
data.description:
An update from Nankai Electric Railway Co., Ltd. ( (JP:9044) ) is now available.

NANKAI Co., Ltd., listed on Tokyo Stock Exchange’s Prime Market, announced a restricted stock incentive plan for eligible manager-class employees through the Nankai Group Employee Stock Ownership Association (ESOA).

Under the plan, the company is scheduled to dispose of up to 23,600 treasury shares at ¥3,143 per share on Jan. 29, 2027, with a maximum total of ¥74,174,800, subject to the number of employees agreeing to participate. Each eligible employee will receive a ¥314,300 monetary claim and 100 restricted shares through the ESOA; the company says the arrangement is intended to promote shared value with shareholders and awareness of management participation.
